disclosure: These are integration boundaries, not live connections, patient risk scores, clinical recommendations or commissioned evaluation authority.

systems.name: AoT
systems.role: Reasoning or organizational layer — authoritative upstream contract not yet verified.
systems.allowed: Display proposed reasoning steps and explicit uncertainty only after a verified schema is mapped.
systems.blocked: No invented AoT scores, medical deductions, patient models or implicit certification.

systems.name: ScoreThat
systems.role: Independent research and instrumentation for provenance, metric integrity, uncertainty and shadow experiments.
systems.allowed: Use future typed provenance/research receipt adapters on the server after contract review; link to the owner now.
systems.blocked: No client-side research tokens, clinical risk scores, live formula changes, or automatic clinical assertion promotion.

systems.name: ELSE v1
systems.role: Independent versioned evaluation authority with scoped shadow API and durable receipts.
systems.allowed: Future authenticated server-mediated shadow evaluations with readback and explicit scope; link to the owner now.
systems.blocked: No direct browser token access, no patient rating mutation, no claim that a shadow result is an approved clinical score.
